card.name: CAS numbers and overdose-data statements
card.fires_on: Digits and hyphens inside a CAS Registry Number (e.g. 7440-48-4), and the word "overdose" in opening lines of overdose sections like "No data are available on overdose".

modes.label: CAS number pieces
modes.description: Digits and hyphens inside a CAS Registry Number in an element description.

modes.label: Overdose in no-data lines
modes.description: The word overdose after "No data are available on" or "No reports of" in an overdosage section.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE No data are available on<< overdose>> of GENVOYA in patients.

modes.label: Citation initials
modes.description: Punctuation after an author's initial in a reference list.
modes.example: Pohl, N<<.;>> Clague, A.; Schwarz, K

card.plain: It lights up on chemical registry numbers and on the word overdose in statements that no overdose data exist.
